name: Feedback Painting
desc: Analog video-feedback canvas where seeded brush attractors smear luminous trails that a slowly zooming, rotating self-stamp blooms into evolving fractal washes.

hue.doc: base paint hue (drifts continuously over time)

rot.doc: feedback rotation: 0 spiral CCW, 0.5 pure zoom, 1 spiral CW

drift.doc: brush wander speed + hue drift rate

x.doc: feedback zoom center + attractor pull x

y.doc: feedback zoom center + attractor pull y

style.doc: render discipline: additive analog glow / subtractive dark ink on cream / false-color heat map / iridescent oil-slick / degraded CRT rgb-split

act.doc: dramaturgy: bloom (slow expansion) / vortex (rotational drift) / pulse (beat-driven zoom bursts)
